_comment: Generation profile for ALL pre-produced voice clips (scripts/gen-voice-assets.js) and on-demand name clips (functions/voiceName.js MODEL_ID/VOICE_SETTINGS, mirrored there + in functions/index.js because functions/ deploys standalone — keep all three in sync). History + evidence: docs/voice-qa/README.md.
_why: Short announcements ('Checkout: Double Twenty.') made eleven_turbo_v2_5 with stability 0.50/style 0.35 hallucinate extra words/sentences and drift accent (Haseeb: 9 of 24 test clips). Same texts with this profile: 0 of 24 (Haseeb) / 0 of 24 (George). turbo_v2_5 with stability 0.80/style 0/language_code=en was still 5 of 24 — the model, not just the settings, is what makes short texts stable. style=0 removes the extra style-exaggeration pass ElevenLabs says increases instability; stability 0.75 keeps delivery consistent across 921 clips.

_previous.systemPrompt: sent as system_prompt — not a documented ElevenLabs TTS parameter; leaving it out did not change the hallucinations
